scene_translation: You had just arrived at Tokyo Station, standing still amid the crowd on the platform. Glancing down at your feet, you noticed a small white envelope lying there. On it, written carefully in ink, were the words: 'To Tesuto.' You looked around, but no one was watching you.
grammar_note: 【〜たばかり】means 'just did something' — 着いたばかり = 'just arrived.' It emphasizes that an action happened very recently. Contrast with 〜たところ, which is similar but more neutral in timing.

mystery_memo: The central mystery begins: a white envelope addressed to the player ('テストさんへ') was found on the platform floor at Tokyo Station — no one nearby could have left it. The envelope has not yet been opened; its contents are unknown. No NPCs have been met yet. This uncanny, personalized message is the mystery's core hook — someone knows the player's name and anticipated their arrival.
